intent_en: To demonstrate that a specific entity (represented by the skull and crossbones) has profit margins surpassing those of Apple, highlighting its exceptional financial performance.
previous_intent: To highlight the exceptionally high profit margins of a hazardous industry, demonstrating that they are substantial enough to make even a tech giant like Apple envious.
narration_support: And with profit margins of over 30%, even Apple should be jealous.
chart_support: Two circular progress charts comparing a skull-and-crossbones icon (with a large red arc) and an Apple logo (with a small blue arc), visually representing a much higher value for the former.
evidence_note: The narration explicitly states high profit margins and a comparison to Apple. The chart visually depicts the entity with the skull icon having a much larger progress bar (red) than the Apple icon (blue), supporting the claim of higher margins.
